products.name: Nike Air Force 1 Umweru n’Icyatsi
products.description: Inkweto za siporo z’uruhu rwiza, zoroheje kandi zikomeye ku muhanda wa buri munsi.

products.name: Nike Revolution Umukara wo Kwiruka
products.description: Inkweto zoroshye zo kwiruka no gukora siporo, zituma ibirenge bihumeka neza.

products.name: Ikoti rya Ankara ry’Ubururu n’Umuhondo
products.description: Ikoti ryiza ridozwe muri kitenge ya Ankara yo ku rwego rwo hejuru, ribera abagabo n’abagore.

products.name: Hoodie y’Icyatsi n’Ipantalo ya Jean
products.description: Umupira w’imbeho wa cotton iremereye utapfuka, ushyushya neza i Kigali mu mvura.

products.name: Amasogisi 3 ya Cotton (Umukara, Umweru, Icyatsi)
products.description: Ipaki y’amasogisi 3 ya cotton akomeye, adashyuha kandi aberana n’inkweto za siporo.

products.name: Inkweto z’Uruhu zo Gusohokana (Ikawa)
products.description: Inkweto z’abagabo z’uruhu rw’ukuri, zikwiriye akazi, ubukwe n’ibirori.

products.name: Isakoshi y’Uruhu, Umukandara n’Indorerwamo
products.description: Isakoshi ntoya yo ku rutugu y’uruhu rwiza rwa kawa, ijyana n’umukandara w’umukara.

products.name: Adidas Court Classic Umweru (Mitumba)
products.description: Mitumba iri ku rwego rwo hejuru, yasukuwe neza nta kintu yangiritseho.

products.name: Ipantalo ya Jean y’Ubururu bwijimye
products.description: Ipantalo ya jean ikomeye, itarangiza ibara igihe imeswa. Size z’abagabo 30 kugeza 36.

products.name: Amasogisi ya Siporo y’Abagore (2-Pack)
products.description: Amasogisi yoroheje kandi afata ikirenge neza mu nkweto za siporo.

products.name: Inkweto za Siporo z’Umukara (Mitumba)
products.description: Inkweto zimeze neza cyane, zidafite inenge n’imwe. Size 43 gusa.

products.name: Ishati ya Ankara y’Abagore (Nshya)
products.description: Ishati ndende y’ibara ryiza rya Ankara ridozwe i Kigali.

products.name: Umukandara w’Uruhu rw’Ikawa (Original)
products.description: Umukandara ukomeye w’uruhu rw’ukuri ujyana n’inkweto zo mu biro.

products.name: Inkweto z’Abagore za Siporo (Umweru)
products.description: Inkweto zoroshye ku birenge by’abagore, ziberana na jean cyangwa ikanzu.

products.name: Indorerwamo z’Izuba za Acetate
products.description: Indorerwamo zirinda izuba (UV400) zifite ishusho nziza kandi zikomeye.

products.name: Hoodie y’Icyatsi (Mitumba Meza)
products.description: Hoodie y’ibara ry’icyatsi yakoreshejweho gake, nta gufana cyangwa gukweduka.

products.name: Inkweto z’Iduka ritarabona Icyemezo
products.description: Iki gicuruzwa ntigishobora kugaragara kuri rubanda kuko iduka rikirimo kugenzurwa.

reports.details: Ndashaka kumenya niba ifoto ari iy’inkweto ya mitumba nyayo cyangwa ari inshya.
